Billing Explanation

Updated this week
Billing cycles

The billing period of 30 calendar days will auto renew each period, even if your account has reached the maximum drawdown limit. You must cancel your subscription before it renews in the Billing section of the members area in order to stop the auto-renewal. Refunds: Due to the digital nature of the accounts, and having granted instant access there are no refunds.

 

Subscriptions for Launch and Propel Plans renew every 30 days at the same price you originally paid. So if you used a discount coupon, it renews at the same price.

 

Manage them here: https://trader.blusky.pro/subscriptions

 

Coupon Codes

If you have a coupon code you need to enter it during checkout. A discount code can’t be refunded, adjusted or switched after the purchase has been submitted. We suggest going slow and purchasing one account at a time at checkout, double checking the coupon is actually applied. If you forget to use the coupon code, absolutely no adjustments can be made after the order has been submitted.

 

 

We use Credit Card Processors, Radom & Digiblox (Crypto) and PayPal to bill you:

All major credit cards (PayPal, VISA, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and ACH) are accepted. Credit cards are charged immediately upon purchase. Addresses and Names must match the billing address of the credit card used. If you have any issues with your payment, please contact support.
​
To troubleshoot any AVS blockers after a payment attempt, kindly refer to the following help article:

 

How to fix AVS errors.

Credit Card and Chargeback Agreement at Checkout

 

Launch Fees

Launch plans carry a one-time Launch Fee that becomes due the moment you pass your evaluation: $99 on the 50K, $149 on the 100K and $179 on the 200K. Stocks plans carry an activation fee of $99 on the 2K and $149 on the 4K and 7K.

You have 14 days from passing to pay, from the Billing section of the members area. If the fee is unpaid on the due date, the account expires immediately and the passed evaluation is forfeited. It cannot be reinstated, and no reset or renewal will restore it.

Propel, Orbit, Instant Sim Funded and Direct to Funded have no launch fee.
